observation.visible_scene: A high-angle, blue-tinted night view of a forest clearing carpeted with fallen leaves, framed by tree trunks in the foreground and background. In the center, three dark vertical silhouettes stand in a loose triangle around a small ground point from which a pale white smoke plume rises; a brighter ember-like spot is visible at the base of the plume.
visible_changes: The white smoke plume persists throughout and its shape, density and outline shift subtly from frame to frame, drifting upward rather than translating across the scene.
The bright spot at the base of the plume remains present the whole time.
The right-hand silhouette stays in roughly the same position and posture across the excerpt.
The left-hand silhouette shows a slight apparent change in outline/position (it looks to lean or shift a little), while the middle dark shape behind the smoke remains largely fixed.
The background trees and leaf pattern keep a constant position relative to the frame edges, indicating a static camera rather than scene translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause or source of the smoke and the identities/intent of the silhouettes are not shown.
Whether the smoke or the figures continue changing after the last frame is unknown.
What preceded the current posture of the left silhouette is not visible.
uncertain_details: It is unclear whether the left silhouette's apparent change is a posture/lean of one figure or a separate object becoming more visible.
The middle dark shape is partly obscured by the smoke, so the exact count and arrangement of standing figures is uncertain.
Whether the plume is expanding or merely drifting in place cannot be firmly distinguished.
